newsitem.title: USA: Viacom provides Paramount films to Europe TV.
newsitem.headline: Viacom provides Paramount films to Europe TV.

text.p: Paramount Television Group, a unit of Viacom Inc, said Wednesday it has signed a pact allowing two European media companies to show Paramount motion picture products on those companies' pay-TV, free television, basic cable and pay-per-view services.
The companies are Television Par Satellite and TCM Droit Audiovisuels.

The licensing agreement allows Television Par Satellite to carry various Viacom/Paramount cable channels and give Paramount options to acquire equity in Television Par Satellite's movie channel and pay-per-view platforms, Viacom said.

Terms were not disclosed, but a source close to the deal values the transaction at $500 to $600 million solely for Paramount's library of motion pictures and television programs, excluding the cable channels.

Under the agreements, Paramount said in a news release it would license its current motion pictures for Television Par Satellite (TPS) and TCM's pay television, free television, basic cable and pay-per-view services.
TPS and TCM will also have access to Paramount's extensive library of motion pictures and television movies for their terrestrial, cable and satellite channels.
In addition, the agreements provide for various Viacom/Paramount cable channels to be carried on TPS's planned digital service.
Paramount said it would also have options to acquire equity in TPS's movie channel and pay-per-view services.
